checked_profile.summary: Secured and unsecured offers with state-specific fees and collateral conditions.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Amounts, terms and APR
facts.text: OneMain advertises $1,500–$30,000, 24–60 months, and fixed APRs of 11.99%–35.99%. State limits and individual qualification can change the available amounts and terms.

facts.label: Collateral
facts.text: Larger amounts generally require a first lien on an eligible insured vehicle no more than ten years old. Secured and unsecured offers differ; covered military borrowers cannot pledge a vehicle.

facts.label: Origination and other fees
facts.text: Depending on the state, origination charges are $25–$500 or 1%–10%, subject to state limits. Late, returned-payment and title-related charges may also apply.

facts.label: Funding conditions
facts.text: One-hour funding requires SpeedFunds disbursement to a bank-issued debit card after closing. Check or ACH availability may take about 1–2 business days and depends on the receiving bank.

questions: What APR, origination fee and net deposit are in my actual offer?
